subject: general
question: Who launched Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Jan Urvarak Pariyojana-One Nation One Fertiliser in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Jan Urvarak Pariyojana (PMBJP) - One Nation One Fertiliser **was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in October 2022.
 
• The aim of this scheme is to ensure the availability of quality fertilizers to farmers at a reasonable price. It is a step towards reducing the dependence of farmers on imported fertilizers.
 
• Under this scheme, the government plans to set up soil testing labs in every district of the country to help farmers understand the nutrient content of their soil and use fertilizers accordingly.
 
• PMBJP also aims to promote the use of organic and natural fertilizers among farmers, which will not only improve the soil health but also reduce the cost of cultivation.
 
• The scheme is expected to benefit around 14 crore farmers across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Smriti Irani is the current Minister of Women and Child Development and Minister of Textiles in the Government of India. She was previously the Minister of Human Resource Development.
 
• Amit Shah is the current Minister of Home Affairs in the Government of India. He is a prominent leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and a close aide of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• Narendra Singh Tomar is the current Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Rural Development, and Panchayati Raj in the Government of India. He has been a Member of Parliament since 2009 and has held various positions in the BJP.
